Hi, could you please your original YAML config if you still have it? If not, do you have a timezone defined in the configuration of the Jewish Calendar integration?

I did comment out entry for jewish_calendar in configuration.yaml:
#jewish_calendar: !include include/jewish_calendar.yaml
Code from jewish_calendar.yaml :
##jewish_calendar
    `  language: english`
    `  diaspora: true`

@bdraco I thought about this some more. Instead of trying to support async in the library which I'm currently not up to, would it be ok if I create the Location object provided by the library using:

location = await hass.async_add_executor_job(Location(...), "Create hdate.Location object")

instead of the current:

location = Location(...)

?

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/480ffeda2ceeedaadaf99c3e25a5d69246ca6170/homeassistant/components/jewish_calendar/__init__.py#L132
That seems like a reasonable fix. You'll probably need to use a `partial` for the `kwargs` https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/asyncio_blocking_operations#running-blocking-calls-in-the-executor
